name: Thoma
notes: The card follows the shield build (Game8's first and KQM's second build): his Skill and Burst shields scale with Max HP, so the card scales on HP with HP% Goblet and Circlet, an ER or HP% Sands, and ER 210 (KQM's C0-C3 figure with Kitain R3 or Favonius Lance; 170-175 from C4). Sets differ: Game8 gives 4pc Emblem of Severed Fate and 4pc Tenacity of the Millelith, KQM 4pc Noblesse Oblige or a 2pc Emblem and 2pc HP% mix; all four are kept, Emblem first because it eases the ER need. Both sources also list a Burgeon sub-DPS build (EM Sands, Goblet and Circlet, Flower of Paradise Lost 4pc with Gilded Dreams as KQM's second, Kitain Cross Spear first); its sets and the EM weight are kept as alternatives, not the main plan. The kit's three 'check' lines (Skill DMG 146%, Burst 88% and Fiery Collapse 58%) are ATK-based Pyro damage on the elemental curve (ratios 1.81, 1.80, 1.79); Fiery Collapse is the only damage that matters, in Burgeon, so the damage talent is the Burst. Both sources level Skill before Burst (KQM: character level first, then Skill = Burst). No ATK or CRIT goal is given. Partners are inferred from the Burgeon and Vaporize roles. Re-checked against genshin-builds.com (2026-10-30): its first build is the Burgeon one (EM on every piece, Flower of Paradise Lost then Gilded Dreams, Kitain Cross Spear first, Skill > Burst), and its community data shows Emblem of Severed Fate (63%) and Tenacity of the Millelith (51%) as the sets players run, with Favonius Lance the most used weapon; both match this card's lists, so the shield-first reading stands, but the Burgeon build is a real second plan.
